$comment: A design-system manifest: the machine-readable contract for one design system. Fill every section; keep it beside the work and in step with the tokens. Sections mirror a design-system editor: overview, colors, typography, spacing, corner radius, shadows, components, assets.

overview.$comment: What the system is for and the rules it follows. Read before designing anything.

colors.$comment: Roles first, then ramp steps. hex values. Never invent a color outside roles and ramps. swatches is the flat list for manifests seeded from a parsed DESIGN.md.

typography.$comment: Two font roles and a fixed px scale. Never name a font family directly; use the tokens. list is the flat family list for manifests seeded from a parsed DESIGN.md.

spacing.$comment: The spacing scale in px, plus the density multiplier that produced it.

radius.$comment: Corner radius tokens. Zero is a valid, deliberate choice.

shadows.$comment: Elevation tokens, already tuned to the ground color. Use them rather than ad-hoc box-shadows.

components.$comment: The CSS class library. Build with these rather than inventing parallel ones.

assets.$comment: How imagery and icons are treated. Every content photograph goes through the treatment.

tokens.$comment: The full flat token list: { name, value, kind } with kind in color|font|spacing|radius|shadow.

files.$comment: Every file of the source system, folder-relative. binary:true marks non-text assets.

starterTemplates.$comment: Copyable starting points that consume the system the intended way.

theme.$comment: The generation knobs the system was derived from. Edit these, then regenerate, not the output.
